questions.prompt: Why does a reader struggle when the page does not show the hierarchy clearly?
choices: Because the reader has to reconstruct the structure silently
Because every document needs more color
Because structure only matters in presentations

explanation.gentle: Hidden hierarchy forces the reader to do repair work alone.
explanation.direct: The page stops helping, so the reader must infer the structure.
explanation.competitive: If the page hides the ladder, the reader has to build it.

questions.prompt: What is the main job of underlined points in this chapter?
choices: To make every sentence look more important
To mark major points the reader should notice quickly
To replace the need for supporting detail

explanation.gentle: Selective emphasis helps the reader spot the main claims.
explanation.direct: Underlining works when it marks major points rather than decorating everything.
explanation.competitive: Use emphasis to signal the load-bearing lines, not to shout at the page.

questions.prompt: What does decimal numbering help reveal?
choices: The weather around the meeting
The emotional tone of each paragraph
The levels and order of the hierarchy

explanation.gentle: Numbering can show how points branch into subpoints.
explanation.direct: It makes levels and sequence visible on the page.
explanation.competitive: Decimal numbering turns hidden rank into visible order.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest value of indented display?
choices: It shows parent and child relationships through spacing
It proves the writer is formal
It removes the need for any summary point

explanation.gentle: Indentation shows what sits under what.
explanation.direct: Spacing can reveal dependence and grouping before the reader parses every sentence.
explanation.competitive: The eye catches the hierarchy before the mind has to rebuild it.

questions.prompt: A memo numbers a list of unrelated thoughts. What is the likely problem?
choices: The numbering reveals a strong hierarchy automatically
Visible cues are being used without a real structure underneath
The writer should remove all formatting from the memo

explanation.gentle: Numbering does not create structure by itself.
explanation.direct: A display method helps only when it exposes a hierarchy that already exists.
explanation.competitive: A numbered mess is still a mess.

questions.prompt: Why does Chapter 6 follow the distinction between deduction and induction?
choices: Because the writer first needs to know what movement should be visible on the page
Because visible structure removes the need to choose a reasoning pattern
Because formatting rules are more important than logic

explanation.gentle: The page should reveal the movement only after the movement is understood.
explanation.direct: Visibility serves the reasoning pattern instead of replacing it.
explanation.competitive: Pick the engine first, then show it honestly.

questions.prompt: A student indents evidence beneath the interpretation it supports. Which chapter principle is being applied well?
choices: Formatting should stay neutral so the reader can guess the structure
Visible display should help the reader see hierarchy directly
Evidence should always be underlined instead of grouped

explanation.gentle: The indentation lets the reader see what supports what.
explanation.direct: The display is carrying part of the explanatory burden.
explanation.competitive: The page is finally doing its share of the work.

questions.prompt: What is the chapter’s central warning about visible formatting devices?
choices: They matter only in school essays
They should be used on every line for consistency
They fail when they decorate the page instead of revealing real structure

explanation.gentle: Display methods help only when they reveal actual hierarchy.
explanation.direct: Cosmetic formatting cannot rescue weak or hidden structure.

questions.prompt: What practical gain comes from highlighting structure well?
choices: The reader spends less effort guessing how the points relate
The writer never needs summaries again
Every document becomes shorter automatically

explanation.gentle: The reader can follow the hierarchy more easily.
explanation.direct: Visible structure reduces repair work and clarifies relationships.
explanation.competitive: The reader stops burning attention on hidden wiring.

questions.prompt: Once the structure is visible on the page, what question comes next in the sequence of chapters?
choices: Whether all numbering should be removed
Whether underlining can replace introductions
Whether the grouping and order themselves are actually right

explanation.gentle: The next issue is testing the grouping order itself.
explanation.direct: Visibility comes before questioning whether the arrangement deserves to stay.
explanation.competitive: After the structure shows itself, it has to survive inspection.
